caseStudies.title: Zero Idea: Facebook Page Recovery
caseStudies.background: "Zero Idea" is a Facebook page with over 400,000 followers built around science and educational content.
caseStudies.challenge: The page was hacked by an attacker based in Vietnam. The legitimate administrator lost access for approximately two months.
caseStudies.investigation: I investigated how the compromise occurred and confirmed the legitimate administrator's ownership of the page.
caseStudies.solution: I worked through the recovery process to restore administrator access, recover ownership, and secure the page against further compromise.
caseStudies.outcome: The page was successfully recovered and administrator control was restored.
caseStudies.keyTakeaways: Extended lockouts (in this case, around two months) are recoverable with a structured, patient approach — even against a determined attacker.
caseStudies.publicReference: The page owner publicly shared a video acknowledging the successful recovery.

caseStudies.title: Dinajpur Image: Case Study
caseStudies.background: Dinajpur Image is a page focused on history and cultural content.
caseStudies.challenge: The page was disabled after false trademark and copyright reports. The reporting party allegedly demanded money in connection with the reports.
caseStudies.investigation: I reviewed the ownership and legitimacy of the page in preparation for the verification and dispute process.
caseStudies.solution: I completed ownership verification, worked through Meta's review process, and assisted with the copyright dispute.
caseStudies.keyTakeaways: False copyright and trademark reports are a real and recoverable threat — ownership verification and Meta's dispute process are the correct path forward.

caseStudies.title: Santali Ari-Chari: Case Study
caseStudies.background: Santali Ari-Chari is a page dedicated to Santali language and culture.
caseStudies.challenge: The page was compromised after being hacked.
caseStudies.investigation: I assessed the compromise and the administrator's legitimate ownership of the page.
caseStudies.solution: I completed account recovery and administrative restoration, then applied security improvements to reduce the risk of repeat compromise.
caseStudies.outcome: The page was successfully recovered, restoring the community's online presence.
caseStudies.keyTakeaways: Recovering a compromised community page is about more than restoring access — securing it afterward is what protects the community it serves.

caseStudies.title: Business Manager Verification: UAE Case Study
caseStudies.anonymizationNote: This case is presented without the client's name pending explicit approval, per the confidentiality decision recorded in the project's Master Blueprint.
caseStudies.background: An AI growth and digital marketing business based in Dubai, UAE, engaged this service for Business Manager support.
caseStudies.challenge: The client experienced multiple Business Manager restrictions and verification issues.
caseStudies.investigation: I reviewed the restriction history and current state of the Business Manager to determine the path to verification.
caseStudies.solution: I resolved the Business Manager restrictions and prepared the Business Manager for Meta's verification process.
caseStudies.outcome: The Business Manager was successfully verified.
caseStudies.keyTakeaways: Verification is often blocked by unresolved restrictions rather than the verification process itself — resolving those first is usually the key step.

caseStudies.title: Delicious Food by Arpa: Case Study
caseStudies.background: Delicious Food by Arpa is a food and cake business based in Bangladesh.
caseStudies.challenge: The business faced fake copyright claims, a restricted advertising account, and Business Manager verification issues, all at once.
caseStudies.investigation: I reviewed each issue individually — the copyright claims, the ad account restriction, and the verification blockers — to determine the correct resolution path for each.
caseStudies.solution: I removed the false copyright issues, resolved the advertising restrictions, completed Business Manager verification, and assisted with Facebook Page verification.
caseStudies.outcome: All requested objectives were successfully completed.
caseStudies.keyTakeaways: Multiple, compounding platform issues can often be resolved together as part of one structured engagement rather than requiring separate efforts.
